import struct

# Read checkpoint header
with open('gpt2-124M.ckpt', 'rb') as f:
    magic = f.read(4)
    print('First 4 bytes (hex):', magic.hex())
    f.seek(0)
    chunk = f.read(200)
    printable = ''.join(c if 32 <= ord(c) < 127 else '.' for c in chunk.decode('latin1'))
    print('First 200 bytes:', printable)
" 2>&1 || echo 'Python check'
